svg.text: His shadow double: a black silhouette with an amber rim, lit eyes and a smile. No legs: below the waist it narrows into one thread tied to whatever feeds it.
amber typewriter, lowercase, typed on letter by letter next to it
the narrator is the opposite: white, sentence case, at the bottom
• amber rim, eyes and smile (the reference's shadow is pink)
• no floor ring: it is tied by a thread to the thing feeding it
• it grows 1 → 4 as it wins; only at 4 does it get his cowlick
• when it loses, the thread goes slack and the glow dies
